content:
bd-h4fc: review/improve 5 built-in workflows (brainstorm/plan/beads/debate/goal) + harden onboard/triage-deep (added by bd-oj9o, now audited). SLICE: fix in builtin_workflows.rs only.

AUDIT FINDINGS (5 bugs + missing guards):
1. Dead spec key: brainstorm.diverge + debate.briefs use spec.prompt — headless dispatch reads task/stage only, so question/proposal NEVER reach the agents. -> task: with {{inputs.question}}/{{inputs.proposal}}.
2. Disconnected reduce/decide: brainstorm.reduce + debate.decide specs never reference {{steps.diverge}}/{{steps.briefs}} — planner/oracle decide blind. -> task consuming fan-out outputs (ADR-0005 Spec 2b parity).
3. triage ack bug: body uses {{trigger.subject}} but message_posted payload has NO subject key. Ack body renders empty even reactively. -> {{trigger.content}} + {{trigger.id}}.
4. goal chain loses context: build/review get generic base prompt; ship calls triage with {{inputs.target}} but triage templates trigger.subject/id -> empty ack + "triage " task on invoke. -> build: stage systematic-execute + plan {{steps.track}}; review: stage code-review + plan {{steps.build}} (harness opencode kept); ship: dispatch_job @housekeeper stage commit-and-push + plan {{steps.build}} (triage stays reactive-only).
5. onboard/triage-deep disconnected: seed never gets {{steps.map}}; prioritize never gets {{steps.triage}}; spawn never gets {{steps.prioritize}}. -> spec.plan extra carries prior step output.
Guards: on_error: fail_run on decisive steps — failed synthesis must not pass silently.

TESTS: +6. All existing tests must stay green.
FILES: src/builtin_workflows.rs (reserved, exclusive).
